name: Lasagne Sundays
description: For Gracie’s Wine Room, we concepted, directed, filmed, edited and delivered a hero reel to promote their Lasagne Sundays activation with the goal of driving bookings and building visibility.
brief: Launch Gracie’s Wine Room’s Lasagne Sundays winter activation, driving Sunday reservations and local awareness through a mouth-watering hero reel showcasing their $18 house-made lasagne.
approach: We introduced a new content direction for Gracie’s, showcasing their lasagne-making process in a way they hadn’t explored before. With a detailed creative brief and shot list, we paired appetising visuals with clear messaging to give viewers a reason to book.
results: The reel received 50,000 views, 850 likes and 900 shares, making it one of Gracie’s most-viewed and most-engaged Instagram posts. The increased visibility helped contribute to two busy months for the venue. Following the launch’s success, we’ve continued working with Gracie’s on campaigns and activations, including Negroni Month.

name: LA Campaign Post-production
description: Abrand needed complete post-production for two campaigns shot in America, with content for General Pants’ in-store displays, Abrand’s website and social channels.
brief: Abrand needed complete post-production for two campaigns shot in America, with content for General Pants’ in-store displays, Abrand’s website and social channels.
approach: We balanced strong product shots with lifestyle footage, creating effortless, adventurous and premium edits that captured the spirit of the campaigns.
results: The content received 63,000 views across Abrand’s social channels, with the client saying they were “blown away” by the final result.

name: Spring Menu
description: Suze Wine Bar wanted to build awareness of the restaurant and showcase its spring menu through engaging social content.
brief: Suze Wine Bar wanted to build awareness of the restaurant and showcase its spring menu through engaging social content.
approach: We put Suze’s standout dishes front and centre, capturing the fresh flavours of the spring menu in reels designed to spark interest, encourage sharing and inspire a visit.
results: The reel received 20,000 views and 300 shares and saves combined, making it one of Suze’s most-viewed reels. The increased visibility contributed to more customer visits and to two busy months for the venue.

name: NYC Campaign Post-production

brief: Tony Bianco wanted engaging, social-first reels using footage shot in New York City to showcase their new collection.
